summary.intent: Plan and begin executing Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) of CipherBox using the GSD workflow — research, generate 4 PLAN.md files in 2 waves, verify them, then auto-chain into execution.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (4 plans committed, verified, 0 blockers). Wave 1 execution of Plan 58-01 was ~60% complete when an API socket error killed the executor; Tasks 0–2 landed in 4 commits but Task 3 (FUSE routing) was uncommitted and Task 4 (JS binding) was not started. A continuation executor was spawned.

repo: Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) is a pure backend crypto/security phase: 4 plans, 2 waves, TDD mode, fine granularity, single requirement HARD-09, decisions D-01..D-13.
`crates/crypto` cannot dev-depend on `api-client/core` (dependency cycle), so cross-language verify vectors live in `crates/fuse/tests/` rather than `crates/crypto/tests/`.
Plan 58-02 requires a human checkpoint at the full-SDK-E2E gate (D-10); local stack must be up (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) — confirmed running.
AUTO_MODE=true on this phase means checkpoint questions auto-advance without prompting.
The GSD commit helper emits `commit_failed` as a known false negative; verify with `git log` rather than retrying.

code.finding: `ciborium` dependency added here during 58-01 Task 0; a stale diagnostic mid-execution incorrectly reported it missing.
New `resolve_ipns_verified` wrapper created in Task 2; routes all 8 unverified FUSE resolve sites through it as the safe-by-default chokepoint.
CBOR decode helper added (RED→GREEN TDD cycle) in Task 1 — handles cid/sequence binding per D-01..D-08.

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch was chosen over parallel-worktree mode for this security phase due to known risks: cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees from prior incidents.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` sections must carry a `(RESOLVED)` marker after questions are addressed in plans, or the plan checker raises a cosmetic warning.
When an executor socket-drops mid-task, committed work survives intact; spawn a continuation executor scoped to the remaining tasks rather than replanning.
The GSD pattern mapper produces a `PATTERNS.md` classifying touched files before the planner runs — this informed the dependency-cycle finding in 58-01.

friction: API socket error killed the 58-01 executor mid-execution (between Task 3 and Task 4), leaving Task 3 changes uncommitted and Task 4 not started — required spawning a continuation subagent.
GSD commit helper emits `commit_failed` false negatives (known bug); requires manual `git log` verification after every commit.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` lacked `(RESOLVED)` markers, triggering a plan-checker warning that required a direct file edit to resolve before the verification loop could close.
Stale mid-execution diagnostic incorrectly reported `ciborium` missing from `crates/fuse` after it had already been added to `Cargo.toml`, causing unnecessary investigation.
open_items: 58-01 continuation: validate + commit Task 3 (routing 8 FUSE resolve sites), complete Task 4 (sdk-core JS symmetric binding), run gates, write SUMMARY.md.
Plan 58-02: Non-CAS embedded-sequence D-09 gate in `upsertFolderIpns`; will pause for human approval at the D-10 full-SDK-E2E checkpoint.
Wave 2 Plans 58-03 (web/sdk-core resolve dedup) and 58-04 (cross-language verify vectors, 7 cases) not yet started.
